boundaries: Original 0x44201b frame addresses, direction/mirror flags, speed/timing, scrolling requests and overlay order. Original horizontal pixel mirror executes; every emitted frame is compared byte-for-byte with the decoded Unit_mov frame/orientation. Plain byte-copy helper supplied. Raster/background copies and host message pump omitted; camera_set captured and coordinates applied. No walking coordinate/occupancy update: caller owns those after each step.
